Cora Gibson

B.A. Environmental Geoscience DePauw University · '27

Structural GeologySedimentologyGeohazard Risk AssessmentSlope StabilityLandslide MonitoringProject Management

Hi, I'm Cora.

I'm an environmental geoscience and civil engineering double major at DePauw University, focused on why the ground does what it does and how to predict it.

I'm drawn to structural geology, hydrogeology, and environmental hazards. Next steps: complete my master's in civil engineering and build a career helping communities prepare for geologic hazards.

Outside of work, you'll find me with a strong coffee, watching Boca Juniors, catching up with family, or getting lost down a new rabbit hole.

Internships

May – Aug 2026 Laurel, Montana Pipelines & Terminals EHS team

CHS Inc.

Environmental Analyst Intern

Based at the Laurel Refinery and traveling to terminals across Wyoming, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Idaho, I worked across four areas of environmental work in the energy industry.

Compliance

Updated floating-roof tank inspection documentation to current regulations, joined tank inspections, and built terminal-specific SPCC inspection forms.

Emergency response

Completed SPCC and FRP training, ran boom-deployment exercises with operators and local responders, and built an ArcGIS map of spill-response equipment.

Remediation

Assisted with a GeoProbe investigation after contaminated soil was found during a sump upgrade, from state notification through remediation planning.

Project oversight

Supported tank-area regrading to improve drainage and a confined-space tank entry for ladder-gasket repair, working alongside contractors.

Research poster

A Summer Under the Big Sky

Environmental compliance, response, and remediation in Montana's energy industry. With Ken Brown, DePauw Department of Geology and Environmental Geoscience.

"Environmental work rarely fits within a single discipline."What I learned at CHS

May – Aug 2025 Canton, Ohio

Metallus

Environmental Compliance Intern

  • Benchmarked spill incidents and EPA enforcement actions across peer companies using EPA ECHO and National Response Center data, then built comparative visualizations and recommendations for environmental leadership.
  • Developed a GPS- and photo-based stormwater outfall inventory to support NPDES compliance.
  • Conducted groundwater and stormwater sampling and maintained chain-of-custody documentation.
  • Attended the Ohio EPA Annual Compliance Conference and presented regulatory updates and sustainability initiatives to the Environmental Health & Safety team.
